events.name: CONDITIONING_UPDATED
events.description: The conditioning state after each learner action — a composed listener (readout, grader) can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.
events.synonyms: conditioning update, associative strength, acquisition, extinction, trial result

events.name: MODE_SELECTED
events.description: Lab router broadcast naming the active mode; this instrument renders when the mode equals matchMode, otherwise renders null.

events.name: RUN_PAIRING
events.description: Learner ran a CS+US pairing trial, driving associative strength toward the asymptote via the Rescorla-Wagner acquisition rule.

events.name: RUN_CS_ALONE
events.description: Learner ran a CS-alone trial, driving associative strength toward zero via the Rescorla-Wagner extinction rule.

events.name: RESET_TRIALS
events.description: Learner reset the trial history — associative strength, trial count, and phase all return to their starting values.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Learning Rate (α)
overridableConfigKeys.description: Rescorla-Wagner learning-rate parameter — the fraction of the prediction error (λ − V, or 0 − V during extinction) applied to associative strength on each trial.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: alpha, learning rate, Rescorla-Wagner alpha, salience, associability

overridableConfigKeys.label: Curve Color
overridableConfigKeys.description: Color of the acquisition/extinction curve polyline and its current-value marker.

overridableConfigKeys.label: History Cap
overridableConfigKeys.description: Maximum number of sampled associative-strength points kept in the acquisition/extinction curve history; older points are dropped once this is exceeded.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: history length, curve window, sample cap

overridableConfigKeys.label: Interactive
overridableConfigKeys.description: Enable pointer interaction on the canvas.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Asymptote (λ)
overridableConfigKeys.description: Maximum associative strength the unconditioned stimulus supports; RUN_PAIRING drives V toward this value, RUN_CS_ALONE (extinction) drives V toward 0.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: lambda, asymptote, maximum associative strength, US intensity, unconditioned stimulus intensity

overridableConfigKeys.label: Match Mode
overridableConfigKeys.description: When composed behind a lab router, the MODE_SELECTED mode value this instrument responds to. Empty string means standalone — render immediately on INIT.
